endorsements.name: Andrew MacPherson
endorsements.label: Maltego Tungsten as a collaborative attack platform
endorsements.description: Maltego has always been a strong favorite for pre-attack intelligence gathering - be that for social engineering, doxing or for infrastructure mapping. Indeed it's earned its rightful place in the Kali Linux top 10 tools.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2013

evidence-links.title: Black Hat USA 2013 - Maltego Tungsten as a collaborative attack platform

povs.explanation: The speaker’s proposal was accepted through the conference’s independent review process. They publicly presented and defended the work at the event, providing verifiable and recognized evidence of the endorsement. We could not verify whether the work is used in industry in situations of real consequence.
